w:r.w:t: Report on NEXT GEN CONNECT 2026 -
Student Skill Development Program
1. Introduction

A one-day Student UpSkill Development Program titled “Next Gen Connect 2026” was successfully organized on 22th July 2026 at Ajeenkya DY Patil University (ADYPU), Pune, with the objective of bridging the gap between academic learning and real-world industry demands for aspiring engineering students.

The event was organized by the IEEE Student Branch, Ajeenkya DY Patil University, Pune, in association with IEEE Young Professionals and IEEE Maharashtra Section. It was envisioned as a platform for 12th pass-out students to connect with industry experts, faculty mentors, and like-minded peers while exploring the ever-evolving world of technology.

The program combined an inaugural ceremony, keynote and expert sessions, a special guest panel, a guided campus and lab tour, and an interactive networking and quiz segment, offering participants a well-rounded introduction to academic, technical, and professional opportunities at ADYPU and within the IEEE ecosystem.
2. Objectives of the Program
To create a platform for students to connect with industry experts and faculty mentors
To provide clarity on academic programs, innovation opportunities, and career pathways at ADYPU
To introduce students to the IEEE Student Branch ecosystem and its technical activities
To offer first-hand exposure to engineering labs and innovation hubs through a guided campus tour
To encourage networking, interactive learning, and healthy competition among participants
To strengthen engagement with IEEE Young Professionals and the wider technical community

6. Event Proceedings
Inauguration Ceremony (10:00 AM – 10:15 AM)

The program commenced with Saraswati Mata Poojan and the ceremonial lighting of the lamp, performed by the dignitaries on the dais, symbolizing the beginning of a day dedicated to knowledge and learning.
Welcome Address (10:15 AM – 10:30 AM)
A formal welcome was extended to all dignitaries, faculty members, IEEE volunteers, and students, setting the tone for the day's proceedings.
Theme Orientation (10:30 AM – 10:45 AM)
Students were introduced to the academic programs, innovation initiatives, and career opportunities available at ADYPU, along with a short IEEE video and briefing.
IEEE Session and Expert Addresses (10:45 AM – 11:35 AM)

Dr. Rakesh Kumar Jain, Dr. Sunny Thomasa, Dr. Deepa Joshi and Dr. Ranjit Kumar addressed the students in succession, sharing guidance on IEEE opportunities, academics, and professional growth, followed by a short felicitation of the dignitaries.
Special Guest Panel (12:15 PM – 12:30 PM)
A distinguished panel of guests shared their perspectives with students, offering diverse insights from academia and industry.
Lunch Break (12:30 PM – 1:30 PM)
A break was provided for all attendees before the second half of the program.
Guided Campus and Lab Tour (1:30 PM – 2:15 PM)
IEEE Student Volunteers led participants on an immersive tour of ADYPU's engineering labs and innovation hubs, giving students a first-hand look at the university's practical learning environment.
Interactive Engagement: Networking Session and Next Gen Valedictory Quiz (2:15 PM – 2:45 PM)
Students engaged in a networking session followed by a lively quiz competition, encouraging interaction among peers and healthy competition.
Concluding Ceremony: Vote of Thanks (2:45 PM – 3:00 PM)
The event concluded with a Vote of Thanks delivered by the Dr. Shankar Khade Sir followed by feedback collection from participants and an official wrap-up of the program.
7. Participation and Engagement
The program witnessed active participation from:
12th pass-out students exploring engineering as a career path.
Faculty members and university officials.
IEEE Student Branch volunteers and members.
Invited dignitaries, guest speakers, and industry panelists.
The blend of formal addresses, panel discussion, a hands-on campus tour, and an interactive quiz ensured sustained engagement and enthusiasm among the attendees throughout the day.
8. Impact and Outcomes
Provided students with clarity on academic and career opportunities at ADYPU.
Strengthened student awareness of the IEEE Student Branch ecosystem and its benefits.
Offered practical, first-hand exposure to engineering labs and innovation hubs.
Encouraged networking between prospective students, faculty, and IEEE professionals.
Fostered a spirit of healthy competition and active learning through the valedictory quiz.
Overall, the program successfully created a platform where academic knowledge, industry exposure, and student networking came together in a single, engaging day.
9. Relevance to IEEE Young Professionals
This program aligned with the mission of IEEE Young Professionals by:
Supporting the professional and academic orientation of prospective engineering students.
Providing networking opportunities with IEEE members, faculty, and industry experts.
Encouraging early engagement with the IEEE Student Branch ecosystem.
Bridging the gap between school-level learning and higher-education/industry expectations.
The event contributed meaningfully to community building and outreach within the IEEE ecosystem, while also serving as an effective platform for student recruitment and orientation.

12. Conclusion

“Next Gen Connect 2026”, organized by the IEEE Student Branch, Ajeenkya DY Patil University, Pune, in association with IEEE Young Professionals and IEEE Maharashtra Section, was a grand success. The program provided an enriching experience for prospective students, offering them clarity, inspiration, and confidence as they consider their next steps toward higher education and a career in engineering.

The organizers express sincere gratitude to all dignitaries, guest speakers, IEEE Young Professionals, IEEE Maharashtra Section, university authorities, faculty members, volunteers, and students for their valuable support in making this program a successful and impactful event.
